description: SAN-1357 Step 8 · Every CopilotKit consumer in MDE, classified before the v2 migration so 'verify-only' is falsifiable instead of assumed. Vocabulary — migrate: must change in a named step; keep: already on the supported v2 surface, no change expected; test-only: a test, fixture or gate that intentionally names v1 or v2 symbols; compatibility-required: must retain a legacy boundary for a documented reason; remove: dead, delete it. Enforced by scripts/__tests__/copilotkit-consumer-inventory.test.mjs: every detected consumer must be listed, no listed file may vanish, and the compatibility <CopilotKit> boundaries must be exactly the four below.
